notes.title: Apology for the Delay in the Release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC
notes.notes:
Hello, this is HIGH-END Games.



We sincerely apologize to all our users for the sudden delay in the release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack, which was originally scheduled for release on Friday, August 22, and deeply regret that we were unable to provide sufficient guidance and communication during the process of deciding to postpone, causing disappointment to those who have been eagerly awaiting the DLC.



Currently, the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack has experienced significant delays due to multiple requests for revisions to the product introduction images during the pre-release content review process on the Steam platform.



As soon as the Steam review process is completed, we will promptly release the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack.



In addition, as an apology for the delay, we will provide the free song "Core" in the update applied on the same day.



We fully recognize that a “release schedule” represents more than just a date — it is an important promise we make to our users, and we  deeply regret failing to keep that promise and the trust you placed in us, and we humbly apologize.



We believe that the primary cause of the delay in the release of the “AQUA BLUE” DLC Pack was our insufficient preparation, as we failed to fully account for the time and variables required for platform-specific review processes within the DLC development schedule.



We will take this experience as an opportunity to thoroughly improve our internal processes for content development and release preparation, and we will also ensure that, in cases where adjusting a release schedule is unavoidable, we will ensure that the reasons and follow-up measures are shared promptly and transparently.



Once again, we sincerely apologize to all our users.



HIGH-END Games

notes.title: Notice of Service Resumption and Delay in DLC Release
notes.notes:

Most of the internal issues for the release have been resolved, but since there are still some remaining issues, DLC-related content will be put on hold while we resume the main service.

We sincerely apologize for the unavoidable delay in the DLC release schedule, and we will provide an update through an official notice once the new release date has been determined.

notes.title: Update Notice (04/16/2025)
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of ‘PLATiNA :: LAB’.
We would like to inform you of the latest updates that will be applied after the service maintenance on Wed, April 16th.


Update Details

 (Settings) You can now manually set a key binding for [PITCH Notes] in the “KEYBINDINGS” tab.
 (Settings) You can now adjust the [Audio Delay Calibration] option in the “GAMEPLAY” tab in 1ms increments.
 (Settings) The default settings for some options in the “GRAPHICS” tab have been changed.

 [V-Sync] : OFF
 [Framerate Limit] : “Unlimted” (Before) → “144” (After)
 (Settings) Fixed an issue where the ‘Duplicate Key Warning’ would not appear during key binding if the in-game language was set to Japanese.
 (Single Play) Corrected the detailed artist credits for the songs “하이틴” and “ミライトコネクト” displayed on the [BOOTH] screen.
 (Single Play) Updated the category label for the song “일상탈출” from ‘Entertain’ to ‘PLATiNA’.
 (Single Play) An original background animation has been added to the song “하이틴”.
 (Research Notes) Revised the content of certain missions included in notes “#0-1 Booting Up Part A” and “#0-2 Booting Up Part B”.

 After the update, the progress of some missions may be displayed incorrectly, such as “4/3” upon first login. However, after playing the game at least once, the progress will be correctly updated.
 In cases where the mission progress method undergoes significant changes, the progress status of the mission will be reset. However, the completion status of the unlock elements in the Research Note will not be reset.
 The original design of the missions was to allow players to unlock content by progressing through the full tracklist of the game. However, this ultimately led to an excessive burden for completing individual missions, resulting in a negative gameplay experience. Therefore, we have improved the overall direction of the missions to allow for a more comfortable unlocking process compared to before. The unlocking experience is something we hold in high regard, and we will continue to make every effort to ensure that you have an enjoyable experience in the future. (P.A.T.C.H.) Fixed an issue where the UI would display incorrectly when switching to a LINES mode tab with no registered songs in the “P.A.T.C.H. Target Song Info.” screen.
 (P.A.T.C.H.) Fixed an issue where the font of the “P.A.T.C.H. Total Points” number displayed at the top right of the mode select and song select screens (within ‘Single Play’ mode) did not match.
 Fixed a typo in the UI when the in-game language was set to Japanese.

 “パタン” (Before) → “パターン” (After) Updated the number of PITCH Notes in the 4LINES PLUS(+13) pattern of “MEGALOVANIA (Camellia REMIX)”.

 This change was made to fix an issue where certain missions in the Research Notes could not be completed as intended. This was done without affecting the intrinsic difficulty of the patterns or the fairness of ranking inclusion. Therefore, existing personal records for the affected patterns will not be reset.
 We fully understand that modifying patterns during live service is a highly sensitive matter that can significantly affect player experience. We will handle such changes with utmost care to minimize the likelihood of similar cases occurring in the future. We sincerely ask for your understanding. Adjusted the judgment interval and related effects applied when holding long notes in certain patterns.


Following this update, we are planning to provide a subsequent update in the near future, which will include changes such as addition of circular notes and fixes for ASIO-related issues. We kindly ask for your continued interest and support.

We will continue to do our best to provide an even better gaming experience.
Thank you.

notes.title: Known Issues and Upcoming Changes (04/14/2025)
notes.notes:
As of April 14, 2025, we would like to provide a preliminary notice regarding key in-game issues that have been identified, and along with the corresponding improvements and fixes that have been scheduled.

These changes are planned to be implemented through an upcoming update, and the specific update schedule will be announced separately via official notices at a later date.



Upcoming Improvements

 A new default note skin featuring a circular design will be added. This skin will be available for immediate use without requiring any unlocking.
 The 'KEYBINDINGS' tab under Settings will be updated to allow players to configure key bindings for [PITCH Notes].
 The [Audio Delay Calibration] option in the 'Gameplay' tab under Settings will be improved to allow adjustments in 1ms increments.
 The default setting for [SPEED] in the play options will be changed from 5.0 to 2.5.
 The overall difficulty of the missions featured in the 'Research Notes' will be reduced. Please note that, due to this adjustment, the progress of certain missions may be reset. We kindly ask for your understanding.
 The 'Research Notes' will be updated to allow players to preview the missions and rewards they have yet to reach.


Upcoming Fixes

 The category label for the track '일상탈출' will be changed from 'Entertain' to 'PLATiNA'.
 The judgment interval applied when holding long notes in certain patterns will be adjusted.
 The 4LINES PLUS(+13) pattern for 'MEGALOVANIA (Camellia REMIX)' will be updated.
 [strike]Due to the pattern adjustments, the previously accumulated clear records will be reset. We kindly ask for your understanding.[/strike]
 (4/15 Added) This change was made to fix an issue where certain missions in the Research Notes could not be completed as intended. This was done without affecting the intrinsic difficulty of the patterns or the fairness of ranking inclusion. Therefore, existing personal records for the affected patterns will not be reset. The detailed artist information for the tracks '하이틴' and 'ミライトコネクト' will be corrected.
 The issue where the number of judgments recorded on the results screen was intermittently displayed as '12345' will be resolved.
 The issue where key inputs intermittently stopped working after switching windows will be resolved.
 The issue where the UI was displayed incorrectly when switching tabs to a LINES mode with no registered songs on the 'P.A.T.C.H. Target Song Info' screen will be resolved.
